faqs.q: What is Curved Type Bollard used for?
faqs.a: Curved Type Bollard is a curved-type cast iron bollard for holding mooring lines on a dock or jetty. It is listed in 8 sizes, 5 t (150 mm) to 100 t (450 mm).

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Curved Type Bollard, such as IH-LR-BM-CB-5T?
faqs.a: Curved Type Bollard part numbers begin with IH-LR-BM-CB and end in a size code: IH-LR-BM-CB-5T is the 5 t (150 mm) size and IH-LR-BM-CB-100T is the 100 t (450 mm) size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes does Curved Type Bollard come in?
faqs.a: Curved Type Bollard is listed in 8 sizes, 5 t (150 mm) to 100 t (450 mm), each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-LR-BM-CB-5T and IH-LR-BM-CB-100T. The table includes 5 t (150 mm): weight 70 kg and 100 t (450 mm): weight 1670 kg.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Curved Type Bollard?
faqs.a: For Curved Type Bollard, choose on the safe working load of the lines and the standard the vessel or berth is built to; the rating assumes structure that can carry it.

faqs.q: What load rating does Curved Type Bollard have?
faqs.a: The listing for Curved Type Bollard gives its dimensions and weights but no working load limit. The load that goes with each size is set by the standard or the maker's data, so tell us the line loads and the standard the berth or vessel is built to and we confirm what can be supplied.

faqs.q: What is Curved Type Bollard made from, and what finish does it have?
faqs.a: Curved Type Bollard is made from cast iron. Cast bollards are bolted down to the quay structure. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: What standard and documents apply to Curved Type Bollard?
faqs.a: The listing for Curved Type Bollard names no standard and no certificate. If your project needs a particular standard, a material certificate or a classification-society or inspection document, state it on the RFQ and we confirm what can be supplied before you order.

faqs.q: What does Curved Type Bollard connect to or work with?
faqs.a: Curved Type Bollard takes mooring lines such as those in our [fibre rope guide](/blog/fibre-rope-materials-compared), and is chosen with the fenders and fittings of the berth. See the [Bollards & Mooring shelf](/c/bollards-mooring) for related bollards and fittings and the [guide to bollard types](/blog/types-of-mooring-bollards).

faqs.q: How should Curved Type Bollard be inspected and looked after?
faqs.a: Check Curved Type Bollard for corrosion, cracks and movement of the base or fixing bolts at each berth inspection, and renew bolts and coatings as needed. Marine bollards also need their foundation and holding-down bolts checked against the line loads.

faqs.q: How does Curved Type Bollard differ from R Type Dock Bollard?
faqs.a: Curved Type Bollard differs from [R Type Dock Bollard](/p/r-type-dock-bollard) in its material Cast iron against Cast steel; 8 listed sizes against 10.
